item.title: Soy Products May Lower Breast Cancer Recurrences
item.description: A major 2024 review article examined the effect of various nutrients on the recurrence of breast cancer. It appeared in the top-tier Journal of the National Cancer Institute, with authors from major institutions on three continents, including Johns Hopkins Medicine, Baltimore.

item.title: Recent Studies Confirm Value of EVOO Against Cancer
item.description: Independent research groups across Europe have published several large-scale studies that independently confirm and strengthen the PREDIMED findings.

item.title: The Power of Plants, Faith and Forgiveness: How Chris Beat Cancer
item.description: Chris Wark, founder of Chris Beat Cancer, is a long-term cancer survivor and author. In this episode, he sits down with Ben Moss and Ralph W. Moss, PhD to share the story that launched his work.

item.title: An Oasis of Healing, PLC
item.description: An Oasis of Healing is a holistic cancer healing center in Mesa, AZ. They offer alternative and natural therapies based on the practices developed by founder, Dr. Thomas Lodi.

item.title: Multivitamins on Trial: The Verdict from 5.5 Million People
item.description: According to U.S. government sources, about half of all Americans, including 70 percent of seniors, take a multivitamin or mineral pill to supplement their food intake (Gahche 2017). But this widespread practice has come under fierce attack in recent years.

item.title: Curcumin & Chemotherapy: Encouraging Clinical Results
item.description: Curcumin may be the most studied natural compound in modern cancer research, yet critics argue that promising findings fail to translate into provable benefits...

item.title: RFK Jr. Announces Nutrition Education in Medical Schools
item.description: Ben Moss reports from Washington, D.C., where HHS announced a new initiative to bring nutrition education into American medical schools. For readers concerned with cancer and chronic disease, this modest step may signal a broader shift toward recognizing the role of food in medicine.

item.title: Targeting Cancer's Metabolic Achilles' Heel
item.description: Dr. Christos Chinopoulos in Budapest shares his deep understanding of cancer’s metabolic pathways and his efforts to target this “Achilles' heel” as part of a comprehensive approach to fighting the disease.

item.title: Albert Szent-Gyorgyi: A Special Gift - Film
item.description: A rare 1984 film portrait of Albert Szent-Györgyi, written by Ralph W. Moss, PhD, and created as a tribute to a brilliant, larger-than-life scientist whose life was devoted to discovery, humanity, and purpose.

item.title: Natural Medicine in Europe: High-Tech Meets Old School
item.description: In this video report from the Medweek Natural Medicine Conference, we take you onto the conference floor for a series of conversations with physicians, researchers, and technology developers working across hyperthermia, metabolism, immunotherapy, oxygen training, and individualized cancer diagnostics.
